title: Doory: free Canva alternative
caption:
Canva Pro charges $18/month. Doory designs your posts and posters for free 🎨

✅ Start from a template or a blank page
✅ Edit text, shapes, photos and layers
✅ Animate it and export PNG, PDF, SVG, MP4 or GIF
✅ No paid plan, no ads, no account needed, 100% free

💻 Any browser (or self-host it)
ℹ️ It's a young project: the editor is complete, but there are only ten starter templates so far.

Comment "DESIGN" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #canva #graphicdesign #design #freeapps #socialmedia #techtips
